title: Normalized coefficient encoding commutes with inverse images and composition
statement: Let A be a finite discrete commutative ring in Type u, R a condensed commutative ring, e: R ≅ A_cont a ring-object isomorphism, and E_T normalized section-action encodings. Let F_T be the actual coefficientEncoding of [def-sfb-finite-coefficient-operation-encoding]. There is a family P_f: Lf*_R ; F_X ≅ F_Y ; Lf*_A for every morphism f:X→Y of arbitrary schemes. For f:X→Y and g:Y→Z and every internal derived R_Z-module M, F_X(c_internal(f,g)_M) ; (P_f)_(Lg*_R M) ; Lf*_A((P_g)_M) = (P_(f;g))_M ; (c_ordinary(f,g))_(F_Z M), where both c are the published total-derived inverse-image composition isomorphisms. No direct-image functor, exchange arrow, properness, qcqs, or boundedness hypothesis occurs.

proof.text: Use the constructed heartPull natural isomorphism for the actual scalar restriction followed by normalized section encoding. Its underived composition equation is heartPull_comp.

Apply the exact functors termwise and localize. The factorization equations for mapDerivedCategorySquareIso and mapDerivedCategoryTriangleIso reduce the derived composition equation, after localization extensionality and cancellation of the invertible factors, to heartPull_comp in every degree.

Transport the coefficient vertices first by the normalized heart equality and then by mapDerivedCategoryCompIso to the actual coefficientEncoding. Transport both pullback edges by their published leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory isomorphisms. Naturality and cancellation preserve the equation. Unfold the published derived compositors to verify their compatibility with the localized underived compositors, and take the resulting constructed family totalPull.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoefficientPullbackEncoding
    (e : Mon.mk R ≅ Mon.mk (coefficient A))
    (E : ∀ T : Scheme.{u}, Encoding A T) :
    ∃ P : Family A R e E,
      ∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
        (M : DerivedCategory (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) Ab.{u + 1})
          (condensedRingObj R Z))),
        (coefficientEncoding A e X (E X)).map
            ((CondensedRing.leftDerivedUpperStarComp R f g).hom.app M) ≫
          (P f).hom.app ((pull R g).obj M) ≫
          (fixedPull A f).map ((P g).hom.app M) =
        (P (f ≫ g)).hom.app M ≫
          (ProEtale.leftDerivedUpperStarComp
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) f g).hom.app
              ((coefficientEncoding A e Z (E Z)).obj M)
